recommendations.recommendation: Oxygen is recommended in patients with SpO2 <90% or PaO2 <60 mmHg to correct hypoxaemia.
recommendations.supporting_text: Oxygen recommended for SpO2 <90% or PaO2 <60 mmHg to correct hypoxaemia.

recommendations.recommendation: Intubation is recommended for progressive respiratory failure persisting in spite of oxygen administration or non-invasive ventilation.
recommendations.supporting_text: Intubation recommended for progressive respiratory failure not responding to oxygen/non-invasive ventilation.

recommendations.recommendation: Non-invasive positive pressure ventilation should be considered in patients with respiratory distress (respiratory rate >25 breaths/min, SpO2 <90%) and started as soon as possible to decrease respiratory distress and reduce the rate of mechanical endotracheal intubation.
recommendations.supporting_text: Consider NIV for respiratory distress (RR >25/min, SpO2 <90%) to reduce distress and intubation rate.

recommendations.recommendation: Intravenous loop diuretics are recommended for all patients with AHF admitted with signs/symptoms of fluid overload to improve symptoms.
recommendations.supporting_text: IV loop diuretics recommended for AHF with fluid overload to improve symptoms.

recommendations.recommendation: Combination of a loop diuretic with thiazide-type diuretic should be considered in patients with resistant oedema who do not respond to an increase in loop diuretic doses.
recommendations.supporting_text: Consider adding thiazide-type diuretic to loop diuretic for resistant oedema unresponsive to increased loop doses.

recommendations.recommendation: In patients with AHF and SBP >110 mmHg, intravenous vasodilators may be considered as initial therapy to improve symptoms and reduce congestion.
recommendations.supporting_text: IV vasodilators may be considered in AHF patients with SBP >110 mmHg to improve symptoms/reduce congestion.
